articles.summary: In an exclusive interview with AlphaStreet, Jay File, CEO of Lite Strategy (NASDAQ: LITS), discusses the company’s Litecoin treasury strategy, the Proof of Time campaign marking Litecoin’s 15th anniversary, and the focus on growing real activity around the Litecoin ecosystem, including the investment in LitVM. The post Our Focus is Centered on Growing Real Activity Around the Litecoin Ecosystem: CEO of Lite Strategy appeared first on Lite Strategy Inc. .
articles.title: Our Focus is Centered on Growing Real Activity Around the Litecoin Ecosystem: CEO of Lite Strategy
